clips.meaning: Gentle torso sway and a small tail-tip movement while both feet stay planted.
Slow head and neck turns to each side, with a slight upper-body follow and planted feet.
Both small wings gently raise and lower while the dragon remains standing on the ground.
A happy shallow bow through the torso and neck, accompanied by a smooth sideways tail flourish, then a return to standing.
